technical.summary: Strong short-term bullish technicals (EMA cross, three white soldiers, volume spike) offset by overbought RSI(9), weak ADX trend strength, and negative CMF divergence—suitable for swing entry with tight stops but not high-probability.

fundamental.summary: NOC shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 84 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (432), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent FOMC decision create severely adverse macro conditions; earnings in 84 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with three white soldiers and 15x volume spike provide textbook short-term bullish setup, and extreme fear sentiment offers contrarian entry opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI(9) at 70.22, weak ADX trend confirmation, negative CMF/AO divergence, price below 50-SMA and 200-EMA, VIX crisis (432), imminent FOMC decision, and zero fundamental/smart money support create a high-probability pullback trap.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows EMA golden cross and volume spike, but overbought RSI(9) at 70.22 with negative CMF/AO divergence signals pullback trap risk. Macro environment (VIX 432, FOMC imminent, rising DXY) and zero fundamental/smart money support make risk/reward unfavorable.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis and imminent FOMC decision create systemic volatility spike that will likely trigger RSI(9) overbought mean reversion, invalidating the technical setup and stopping out swing entry.
